item.title: Thursday brings dramatic cooldown, severe storms
item.description: After a wild weather day with heavy rain, strong storms, and a 30-40 degree cooldown, temperatures will fall to freezing tonight, with sunny and breezy weather expected on Friday before another strong front brings showers and storms on Monday.

item.title: ‘He never talks back’: Rock Hill café has robotic baristas, but don’t call them Mr. Coffee
item.description: At Techno Café in Rock Hill, customers can experience a high-end coffee experience with the help of robotic baristas named Adam and Eve, who are programmed to provide a unique and efficient service.
